newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse to remain shut for one week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse to remain shut for one week.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange said on Tuesday it would remain shut for a week because of local holidays.

It announced that the bourse would close on Wednesday for an official strike to protest at what Pakistan calls Indian occupation of Moslem majority-Kashmir, on Thursday for a religious holiday, then for the Friday-Saturday weekend, and from Sunday to Tuesday for the Eid al-Fitr Moslem feast.
If the Eid, which depends on the sighting of the new moon, falls on Monday, the exchange will stay closed on Wednesday.
